entities.summary: Ludwig Wilding was a German visual artist, whose work is associated with Op art and Kinetic art. Wilding lived in Düsseldorf, and Westheim, Germany. Ludwig Wilding was a painters & sculptors from Grünstadt (1927-07-15, Grünstadt–2010-01-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
